How we build a walnut slat wall

Homeowners often price slat panels online and wonder why an installed wall costs more than the material. The difference is the fitting: walls are never perfectly flat, corners are never perfectly square, and outlets never land where the panel rhythm wants them. Our crew scribes, cuts and adjusts on site so the finished surface reads as one continuous piece of joinery. That is also why we photograph your actual wall during the design stage - the layout is planned around your baseboards, outlets and door casings.

What Bellflower clients ask us

How much does a walnut slat wall cost in Bellflower?

A walnut slat accent wall in Bellflower starts at $2,500 for a standard TV-wall section. Full-width and floor-to-ceiling layouts are priced by the written estimate after your design preview - materials and labor are itemized, nothing is bundled into a mystery number.

Do slat walls help with echo?

Yes. The felt backing absorbs mid and high frequencies, which is why slat walls are popular in open-plan living rooms and media rooms with hard floors - the room sounds calmer, not just looks it.

Can slats go around corners and doors?

Yes. Panels are cut on site for corners, outlets and door casings, and we offer matching slat-faced hidden doors when a door sits inside the accent wall.

How are slat walls maintained?

A dry or slightly damp microfiber cloth is enough. The veneer is pre-finished; no oiling or sanding is needed.
